scope: setup01 including 12 corrected reruns. Auth, blog, guest and PB-016 are outside this lane.
method: Independently viewed every main and controls PNG in width-grouped panels (full mobile, enlarged desktop central application region and separate full desktop overview), compared actual design PNG families and applicable component states. SHA-256 computed over original files. Opening flow/alerts/probes/guards from supplied captures and implementation readback. Design images are guidance; do not treat approved design counts as runtime validation.

styles.interpretation: Visual comparison by control purpose, order, wrapping, semantic color, enabled/disabled state and access after scroll. No per-pixel equivalence. Native file widgets use capture browser language. Actual wizard is left-aligned; design boards use several different alignments. Narrow layout legitimately stacks actions and scrolls.

limits: Only the captured light-theme browser widths. No external GitHub/Gitee network, OS file chooser, physical touch/keyboard, screen-reader or visually inferred API-success claim.

Focus is programmatic where measured. Actual dialog select dropdown, confirmation or Escape return are not certified by a generic hit probe. Unmeasured offscreen regions are not declared visually correct.
Success, pending and deliberate fault fixtures are differentiated by the individual recipe/sidecar. In particular initializing overrides only the returned non-ready status phase.

SOURCE-CUE.finding: 来源选择卡只有前景、底色和细边框颜色表达选中。MP-D078/R046/R047/R048 给出独立的勾或选中标记，产品源码已有 aria-pressed。

GIT-FEEDBACK.finding: 提交后停在长表单底部。手机主图和控件图均无该次结果、核对或重试操作。错误在页面更高处，仅向上滚动可找到。

RECEIPT-ACTION.finding: 已有未确认请求时，主按钮仍是“导入并继续”，实际点击走 startJob 的 unresolved → reconcile。核对操作和按钮名称不同。

RESUMED-JOB.finding: 恢复已接受的 clone 后任务卡未标明仓库，禁用 URL 为空、名称恢复“我的知识库”，无法识别正在下载哪个库。

UNAVAILABLE.finding: 注册表暂时读失败时同时显示“暂未提供此功能”与启用的“添加”按钮。可用性未知却显示成不可用；按钮仍会尝试安装。

FILE-PRECISION.finding: 262145 字节显示 256.0 KiB，与页面“不超过 256 KiB”的规则及超限错误同屏矛盾。

SMALL-FILE.finding: 非空小文件的大小回执显示 0.0 KiB，用户无法区分它和空文件。

FINISH-SPINNERS.finding: 只选择了进入工作区，但创建笔记与进入工作区同时显示极浅的 spinner。两个动作均须锁住，只有当前请求应标明执行中。

CLIPPED-PROBE.finding: 目录控件探针上限为 160，实际找到 208；页面确有截断和路径回退，不能宣称已量测其余每一个控件。

INNER-INPUT.finding: 透明 Ant combobox input centerHit=false，输入可获焦。未看到其他控件遮挡，recipe 未验证该下拉的选择动作；本表不认证其指针操作。

STATUS-CTA.finding: 检查/重试是该阶段唯一可用的主操作，但实际为白底细边，与 MP-D085 蓝色主操作层级不同。
